name: failed-deploy-and-pipeline-flakiness-reporter
description: Reports cross-provider pipeline failure and flakiness trends across GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, and Azure DevOps, and ties each hot spot to the AWS resources the failing stages target. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (a custom CI MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on TUE at 07:00 UTC
